name: Equipment / Tool Rental (Peer-to-Peer)

yield.notes: For owned tools/equipment only. Camera gear, trailers, camping equipment perform well.

flags: Insurance gap: verify coverage for rental use

prerequisites: Equipment you already own: power tools, camera gear, camping gear, trailer
startup_checklist: Inventory owned equipment with condition assessment
Check insurance coverage — add rider if needed for rental use
List on Fat Llama, RentOtherStuff, or local Facebook groups
Set competitive daily/weekly rates based on comparable listings
Create damage deposit workflow and clear rental agreement
failure_modes: Equipment damaged by renter beyond deposit coverage
Low demand for your specific equipment type in your area
Insurance claim required — drives up future premiums
kill_criteria: Equipment sustains significant damage in first 6 months
Less than 2 rentals per month despite competitive pricing
sources_note: Income ranges from peer-to-peer rental platform data.
